claim: All 20 original-Xbox co-op maps preserve a complete source-exact paired player spawn topology with contiguous levels and linked advancement targets.

inputs.source_binding: Each final manifest's decoded source MAP SHA-256

source_authored_attention.decision: Preserve authenticated positions and orientations; do not synthesize safe spawns or normalize authored facing without a gameplay witness.

limits: Static pairing does not prove which point the runtime selects, telefrag avoidance, spawn effects or host/client synchronization.
Incoming target links do not prove activation count or order; progressive respawn remains a native two-peer test obligation.
The three maps without a safe-spawn entity and six angle differences are identical to the decoded Xbox sources, not port-introduced loss.
